look: Void Wraith, a A-rank GKOM variant from the Gloomshades family: tall tattered wraith around a tear in the air, crimson orb heart. Family anatomy: ghostly translucent shades, banshees and wraiths trailing shadow smoke. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: most of the body sheathed in GKOM crystal, natural surface only at the seams; the crystals are violet shade crystal. A grapefruit-sized GKOM core orb, near-black with a liquid shimmer, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, vivid sweeping shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils
